To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AlNi-pillared clay is a promising catalyst support for the adsorption/desorptive combustion of benzene, and the addition of CeO2 to the catalysts can improve its performance.

the CeO2-modifed Pd/AlNIPILC catalysts were synthesized by impregnation, and the adsorption/desorptive catalytic combustion performance of the catalysts for benzene were studied, and the results showed that the 0.2 % Pd/12 % Ce/AlNi-pillared clats catalysts presented good catalytic performance, and the catalysts also displayed good resistance for water and the chloro-compound.
the AlNi-PILCs were successfully synthesized, which exhibited high performance for adsorption/desorbption-catalytic benzene combustion, especially for the 0.2 %Pd/12. 5% Ce/ AlNi-PILCS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of AlNi-pillared clay and its application in benzene adsorption/desorptive combustion.
the development of a new functional AlNi-PILCs and its supported catalysts with high catalytic performance for benzene adsorbed combustion.
the synthesis of AlNi-pillared clay and its application in the adsorption/desorptive catalytic combustion of volatile organic compounds.

the AlNi-PILCs with a large SBET and a large d001-value could provide high benzene adsorption capacity.

this work has provided a new method for the preparation of AlNi-PILLC with high specific surface area and pore size and the development of a new functional catalyst for benzene adsorbed/desorption-cata-lytic combustion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adsorption/desorptive catalytic combustion is a new method for VOCs removal, and the AlNi-PILCs with high surface area and d001-value are promising supports for VOCs removal.

AlNi-PILCs with large SBET and d001-values could be applied as supports for the preparation of catalysts for the removal of volatile organic compounds, and the PdCeO2/AlNi-PCLC catalysts with high dispersion of Pds and CeO2 could be applied for the adsorption/desorptive combustion process.
the AlNi-PILCs were a promising material for the adsorption/desorptions-catalytic combustion process.
